positions.title: Web Developer Student
positions.description: Through hands-on projects and collaboration with my peers, I am gaining experience in front-end and back-end development, database management, and API integration.

positions.title: Insurance Agent
positions.description:
•	Provided exceptional customer service in a high-volume call center.
•	Utilized product knowledge and customer protocols to resolve issues efficiently and reduce wait times. 
•	Continuously held a 95% customer satisfaction rating for providing excellent customer service. 
•	Effectively relayed contract language, options, and limitations to ensure the customers’ understanding.  
•	Identified potential gaps in insurance coverage and recommended solutions. 
•	Used knowledge database to troubleshoot through system failures and escalated per protocol.
•	Documented call and notated all troubleshooting steps and resolution.

positions.title: Financial Analyst Intern
positions.description:
•	Performed financial forecasting and variance analysis on capital expenditures 
•	Analyzed and researched financial information to produce ad-hoc reports for my team. 
•	Created pivot tables to filter through financial data and find outliers that were not within budget.
